rate_selection: Lowest strictly sufficient rate among reference[::M] candidates; integer-only family is our design choice, not a physical constraint or global optimum.
pre_decimation_filter: None for this measured clean reference; sub-Nyquist source content is verified. Not a general unfiltered-decimation rule.
reconstruction: Real periodic Fourier interpolation, same 2 s period; scale L/N and split old Nyquist coefficient when expanded.
evaluation: All 96000 original grid positions, no trimming, fitted gain, phase adjustment or time alignment.
limitations: Periodic-record clean-sampling baseline, not a claim of perfect reconstruction for nonperiodic/noisy data or a practical causal filter. Full stochastic system evaluation remains pending.
